translations.web: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.
translations.bsb: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east and gather you from the west.
translations.kjv: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
